title: Died after about 6 uses.
text:
Died after about 6 uses.. [[VIDEOID:3771fa2415bbef1a5f9d2b062c9ae074]] I loved this when I first got it. It did a pretty decent job of vacuuming and sealing. I used it maybe every other month to seal up spices or meats. It isn't large and a quart bag is the biggest size you can use on this one.
BUT - just got it back out to seal several pounds of wild rice. It vacuums out the air just fine, but the heating strip no longer works!! So here I sit with a freshly opened five-pound bag of wild rice and cannot sral it up. I also had a stack of mylar bags I had planned to heat seal as well.
Nope. Dead in the water. One year later, with using it approximately six times.
Of course, it is well past the return date.

Get something better if you are serious about food storage. This one can't cut it.
